scheme_name: Odisha Sahaya Scheme - Pre & Post Matric Scholarship
other_conditions: Applicant must be a bona fide resident of Odisha.
Applicant must be a beggar or a child of a beggar.
Applicant must be a regular student of a recognized educational institution studying in India.
Applicant must not be receiving any financial assistance from State or Central Government under any other scheme.
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly scholarship ranging from ₹800 to ₹2,000 for up to 10 months per academic year to child beggars and children of beggars pursuing pre‑matric, post‑matric, graduate, postgraduate, or professional courses.
documents_required: Certification/recommendation by the head of the educational institution
